source: A real capture (2026-10-31, RyzenShine): a Keychron M6 on its USB cable, 3434:d064, its vendor node (interface 4, usage page 0xFFC1). The status request got the same answer as through its Link-KM dongle but for the battery byte, 0xE3: 99 % with the top bit set while it charges (0xE2, 98 %, a minute before). Its dongle answered nothing meanwhile.
